notes.title: 🎉🍓High Fructose Joins Brutal Indies Unleashed
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m excited to share that [b]High Fructose[/b] will be featured in the brand-new showcase [i]Brutal Indies Unleashed[/i] starting today! This is the first showcase dedicated entirely to intense, action-packed indie games, and I’m honored that High Fructose is part of the lineup.[/p][p]The showcase kicks off tonight with a 30-minute pre-show, followed by the full event. Here are the start times:[/p][p]🕗 8:30 PM ET (Pre-show) / 9:00 PM ET (Main show)
🕖 7:30 PM CT / 8:00 PM CT
🕔 5:30 PM PT / 6:00 PM PT
🕓 1:30 AM BST / 2:00 AM BST (Sept 13)[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support.  Let’s put indie games on the map![/p][p]– Chris

YouTube link below!

[url="https://www.youtube.com/live/KqrV_JBmqHM"]https://www.youtube.com/live/KqrV_JBmqHM[/url][/p]

notes.title: PAX West - Gameplay stream! (pre-recorded)
notes.content: [p]The fight isn’t over—it’s only getting bigger. 🍓🍌🎃[/p][p]Join us at PAX West for the updated demo of [b]High Fructose[/b], the over-the-top FPS roguelite where you battle monstrous fruit with cinematic glory kill–style finishers. Drawing on my experience animating [i]DOOM Eternal’s[/i] iconic glory kills, this new build cranks up the intensity with brutal new animations and tighter combat flow.[/p][p]🎮 [b]What’s new in this demo:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Glory kill–style finishers inspired by my [i]DOOM[/i] animation work, bringing cinematic brutality to fruit combat[/p][/*][*][p]Updated combat flow with faster pacing and refined controls[/p][/*][*][p]Balance updates for smoother, more intense runs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👉 Be sure to [b]Wishlist [i]High Fructose[/i] on Steam[/b] to stay updated.[/p]

notes.title: Glory Kill Mechanic Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m deep in development on a [b]glory kill-style execution system[/b] for [i]High Fructose[/i], and it’s already feeling [i]very[/i] satisfying. Right now, these cinematic finishers trigger when you complete a recipe—letting you absolutely obliterate the final enemy in style.[/p][p]For those who don’t know, I animated about [b]one-third of the glory kills in [i]DOOM Eternal[/i][/b], so bringing that kind of over-the-top, visceral flair to a fruit-slicing ninja game feels like a natural progression. [/p][p]This system is just getting started. I’m planning to expand it with character-specific finishers, unique kill animations per enemy type, and maybe even some surprises based on your loadout.[/p][p]Thanks for playing and following development—your feedback means a lot as [i]High Fructose[/i] continues to evolve into the most stylish, fruit-splattering FPS around.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qEoxOWPLaKM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Here's[/p][p]
—Chris 🍓🗡️[/p]

notes.title: 🧃 The Demo Is Basically free Early Access – Come Shape the Game ⚔️
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]The [i]High Fructose[/i] demo is staying live! 🧃[/p][p]🍓 I’ve gotten a ton of great feedback during Steam Next Fest — huge thanks to everyone who jumped in and shared thoughts.[/p][p]⚔️ At this point, the demo is more than just a demo — it’s become a community-driven slice of the game. I’m actively shaping [i]High Fructose[/i] based on your feedback.[/p][p]🛠️ I’ll be going through everything and making updates soon. Once those changes are live, I’ll post an update [b]here in the forums[/b] so you can see what’s new and what’s coming.[/p][p]🎮 [i]If you haven’t played yet, this is a great time to check it out.[/i] The demo gives you a solid feel for the game—and playing now means you’re part of the process as it evolves.[/p][p][u]💬 [b]There’s a feedback form on the main menu screen inside the game, or feel free to drop your thoughts here in the forums.[/b][/u][/p][p]🍊 Thanks again for all the support. Let’s keep building something juicy (and a little dangerous) together.[/p][p]– Chris[/p]

notes.title: Overdrive Recipe Added – Wave 2 Just Got Juicier 🍊⚡
notes.content: [p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback about the recipes in [i]High Fructose[/i] – and we heard you loud and clear: you want recipes that hit harder and feel more impactful.[/p][p]Starting now, you’ll get access to a [b]new Overdrive recipe[/b] at the beginning of [b]Wave 2[/b]. It’s designed to shift momentum and give you that extra punch when the fruit fight starts heating up. ⚔️🍍[/p][p]This is just the beginning — we’re continuing to tweak and expand the recipe system based on your feedback.[/p][p]🗣️ [b]Try it out and let us know what you think![/b] Your input helps shape the future of the game.[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Surprise! High Fructose is part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752524/46c831347597a9be2c431b13e54978cecc9e7281.png[/img]
🛠️ I’m a solo developer, and this project has been a labor of love! With some help from some of my talented friends.
If you try the demo, I’d be incredibly grateful for your feedback — every comment helps me improve the game.

👀 What’s new in this demo?

🌀 One of the features I’m most proud of is the recipe system — a unique mechanic where you collect ingredients mid-battle and activate powerful abilities using a dynamic recipe wheel. It’s fast, strategic, and brings something fresh and original to the genre. I'm actively improving this and coming with exciting recipes for you to use - if you have something you want let me know!

🧍‍♂️ I love the Monkey character — he’s not playable yet, but he’s coming down the line and will bring his own wild playstyle.  My characters are inspired by Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and he's like the Michaelangelo personality of the group.

💥 The new demo features procedurally generated arenas — so every wave feels fresh. Craft powerful recipes mid-battle, counter incoming attacks, and  slo-mo dash through chaos in style.

🔫 Weapon auto-fire improvements

🧃 A fresh batch of fruit monsters

🧠 Smarter AI + controller fixes

🐻 And yes... the Bear Cannon. You're welcome. Now with PANDAS!

📅 Available now
👉 Play the Demo Now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506550/High_Fructose/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506550/High_Fructose/[/url]

💚 Don't forget to wishlist and share if you like it!

notes.title: Two new Characters annoucment!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752524/4ea36b0f5b5a44e875f242c95594608ad5385d56.png[/img]
Introducing Isamu, the newest playable character in High Fructose! Step into the shoes of this mighty ninja elephant and take the fight to the monster fruit. With his unparalleled strength and tactical prowess, Isamu is a force to be reckoned with.

Isamu brings a unique playstyle to the battlefield. He can equip up to 6 powerful guns at once, letting you customize his arsenal to suit your strategy. And when things get tough, unleash his devastating ground pound ability, crushing enemies around him in one powerful blow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752524/551dee43503ea3ae9dc08f17a8e6ded536d73813.png[/img]
Coming soon..... The next playable character: the Wolverine! This ferocious fighter takes a bold approach as a melee-only powerhouse, leaving guns behind to deliver devastating close-range attacks. Get ready to unleash pure fury on the monster fruit!
